claims.content: Receive situational awareness information from the Surveillance NPG including track and Reference Point data necessary to support the platform mission.

goal.raw_text: Receive situational awareness information from the Surveillance NPG including track and Reference Point data necessary to support the platform mission.

claims.content: Non-C2 JU
C2 JUs participating in the exchange of J3 Surveillance messages shall transmit surveillance information in Network PGs as defined in paragraph 4.2.3.10.5.
Non-C2 JUs shall not transmit on the Surveillance NPG.
C2 JUs transmit surveillance information in Network PGs as defined in paragraph 4.2.3.10.5.

trigger.raw_text: C2 JUs transmit surveillance information in Network PGs as defined in paragraph 4.2.3.10.5.

claims.content: Non-C2 JUs receive situational awareness information from the Surveillance NPG including track and Reference Point data necessary to support the platform mission.
The received surveillance information includes point surveillance data included in the J3.0 Reference Point message and the J3.1 Emergency Point message.
The received surveillance information includes Air and Surface (Maritime) surveillance data included in the J3.2 Air Track message and the J3.3 Surface (Maritime) Track message.
The received surveillance information includes Subsurface (Maritime) surveillance data included in the J3.4 Subsurface (Maritime) Track message.
The received surveillance information includes Land (Ground) surveillance data included in the J3.5 Land (Ground) Point/Track message.
The received surveillance information includes Space and Ballistic Missile surveillance data included in the J3.6 Space Track message.
The received surveillance information includes Electronic Warfare surveillance data included in the J3.7 EW Product Information message.
If a JU drops or ceases reporting SA information after having reported on the interface, it shall transmit a J7.0 (ACT = 0) message.
A J7.0 (ACT = 0) message shall not be transmitted on remote reports; remote reports may be automatically purged based on system criteria.
Non-C2 JUs shall monitor the Surveillance NPG to support their missions but are prohibited from transmitting on this NPG.
Remote surveillance track and point data available in the J3 series messages shall provide non-C2 JUs situational awareness and early warning information.
If a correlation is not found, the C2 JU shall integrate the received PPLI report into its surveillance database as part of the surveillance picture.

If J2 messages are not received subsequent to this action and the receiving C2 JU still has no local data, the C2 JU assumes no responsibility for reporting the subject JU on the Surveillance Network PG.
If the position or other data in a PPLI meet a system's decorrelation criteria, the PPLI and local track data shall be decorrelated.
After decorrelation, the C2 JU shall maintain a surveillance track report with locally held data using a new track number.
The PPLI Track Number and Identity Indicator field and the PPLI IFF/SIF Indicator field shall both be removed as to statement.

A C2 JU shall assume R² of an IU (including C³ and non-C³ JUs and Forwarded TUs and ROs) in accordance with the reporting rules for a real-time track if the C2 JU has correlated local sensor data when: a J2 PPLI message is not received for 40 to 60 seconds, or a J2 PPLI message, other than C2.0, is received with the NPS indicator set to Inactive or Conditional Radio Silence, or a J7.0 (ACT = 0) Drop Track message is received from the KUJ for a PU, RU, or other IU, or the Geodetic Position Quality in the J2 PPLI message is set to value 0.

A C2 JU assuming R² of an IU reports it as a track or point on the Surveillance Network PG. The type of surveillance message will depend upon the Environment/Category of the IU being reported. The Identity shall be reported as Friend. The Track Number, Platform and Platform Activity values received in previous PPLI messages shall be reported. The PPLI Track Number and Identity indicator shall be reported as value 1, and shall be maintained if another C2 JU assumes R² of the IU.
Non-C2 JU has received situational awareness information from the Surveillance NPG including track and Reference Point data necessary to support the platform mission.
The received surveillance information includes point surveillance data included in the J3.0 Reference Point message and the J3.1 Emergency Point message.
The received surveillance information includes Air and Surface (Maritime) surveillance data included in the J3.2 Air Track message and the J3.3 Surface (Maritime) Track message.
The received surveillance information includes Subsurface (Maritime) surveillance data included in the J3.4 Subsurface (Maritime) Track message.
The received surveillance information includes Land (Ground) surveillance data included in the J3.5 Land (Ground) Point/Track message.
The received surveillance information includes Space and Ballistic Missile surveillance data included in the J3.6 Space Track message.
The received surveillance information includes Electronic Warfare surveillance data included in the J3.7 EW Product Information message.
